peer_identity.arc_label: Giant golden deity figure—power source of the Shabda-Oud, destroyed by Aghnar's bomb arm
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Treated by Shabda-Oud as godlike and immortal. Giant golden humanoid. Externally impenetrable—vulnerable only from within. Central power source for all Shabda-Oud psychic abilities; their collapse when he is destroyed confirms this. Invoked as religious authority. Destroyed when Aghnar baited him into biting off a bomb-rigged arm.
peer_identity.rationale: Both records describe the same entity: vol07 is the active encounter where Jejoh bites off Aghnar's arm and is destroyed by the concealed mini-bombs; vol08 is a recap reference to the same destruction. Straightforward merge.

important_actions: Bit off Aghnar's arm, triggering the concealed mini-bomb trap (vol 7 p21)
Was destroyed when internal mini-bombs detonated in his stomach (vol 7 p21)
His destruction caused the Shabda-Oud witches to collapse catastrophically as a fighting force (vol 7 p23)

character: Sama-Wajd; type: intended genetic progenitor in Shabda-Oud plan; notes: Named as the intended sperm donor in the ritual to produce Sama-Wajd via Oda (vol 7 p16)
character: Aghnar; type: enemy / destroyed by; notes: Aghnar baited Jejoh into biting off his arm; the concealed mini-bombs then detonated inside Jejoh's stomach, destroying him (vol 7 p21)
traits: Treated by other characters as godlike, immortal, or a deity figure
